author: smorgasburg
title: Looking for local illustrator for 2027 NYC vendor application flyer
content: Smorgasburg, through your eyes. 🎨 Calling all local artists! We’re looking for a local illustrator or designer to create our 2027 NYC vendor application flyer! This is a paid commission, with full artist credit and the potential for many future collaborations. We want to see something different from our past flyers. Something unmistakably New York that captures the messy, human experience of eating here: hands making food, friends sharing a bite, cultures meeting across a counter. Your style, your perspective. Submit your portfolio or Instagram through the link in bio by November 10. A sketch is optional, but including one helps us understand your vision and may speed up our review—rough ideas are welcome. The final flyer, featuring the selected artist’s work, will be posted on November 20. Know someone we should see? Tag them below. Contact: link in bio.

author: factornotes
title: Hiring Illustrator for stationery collections and brand campaigns
content: At Factor Notes, we love turning creative ideas into visuals that inspire, connect and tell a story. We’re looking for a talented and detail-oriented Illustrator to join our team and create original artwork for our stationery collections and brand campaigns. If you have a passion for illustration, a distinctive creative approach and an eye for bringing concepts to life through visuals, we’d love to hear from you! What You’ll Do: Illustration & Artwork: Create original illustrations and artwork for our stationery, planners, product collections and brand campaigns. Concept Development: Develop creative concepts, patterns, characters and visual elements that align with our brand identity. Team Collaboration: Collaborate with the design, content and marketing teams to develop visuals that tell a cohesive brand story. Creative Exploration: Experiment with illustration styles and contribute fresh ideas for product launches, seasonal collections and marketing campaigns. Who You Are: Experienced: Have 0–3 years of experience in illustration or a related creative field, supported by a strong portfolio of original work. Technical Proficiency: Be proficient in digital illustration tools such as Adobe Illustrator and Procreate. Creative Expertise: Have a strong understanding of colour theory, composition and visual storytelling, along with excellent attention to detail. Interested in joining our team? Mail your resume and portfolio to: careers@factornotes.com

author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for animated series
content: 🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: * Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. * Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. * Ability to match an established cartoon art style. * Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). 📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to: * jobs@jumpanimation.com * gawad26@gmail.com 💬 You can also message us directly through Facebook! If you’re passionate about cartoon backgrounds and 2D animation, we’d love to hear from you!

author: egofilm_studio
title: Seeking Lead Illustrator and Background Illustrator for animated series
content: 🎬 EGoFILM poszukuje Lead Ilustratora oraz Background Ilustratora! Jeśli masz doświadczenie w pracy przy projektach animowanych, prześlij swoje portfolio na: 📩 rekrutacja@egofilm.pl Do zobaczenia!
